ci_attestation_subject: ADP V0.2 P09 follow-up: fetch-failure visibility + edge diagnosis of the six zero-item sources
summary: P09's coverage view surfaced six sources that had never ingested a single item. Each was probed FROM the Cloudflare edge (probe never deployed): cell, cell-neuron, lancet and science-advances return 403 and gnews-us-tech returns 503, while the same URLs return 200 with real items from a normal client -- the publishers and Google block datacenter IPs. Those five are NOT fixable here: bypassing needs a proxy or paid egress (violating DIR-007), and circumventing bot protection is not a call to make unilaterally. stats-gov is different: it IS reachable from the edge (200, 66KB, 3.4-6.7s) and the SHIPPED parseA0 regex matches 15 of 18 article links on the live page, so the parser is correct and P04's '15 items' claim was accurate -- it is an intermittent fetch failure, not a parse bug. (The implementer first suspected the parser; that was the probe's own wrong expectation -- the page uses relative hrefs -- and is recorded as such.) The system had been honest all along: cn_run_log records degraded ['feed:science-advances','a0:stats-gov'] and cn_sources.health records degraded/disabled_auto; no page surfaced it, which is exactly what T043 exists to fix. /system now shows both the never-ingested sources and the unhealthy ones with their health. DISCIPLINE: health is presented as a SOURCE-level fact and never sinks into a per-cell historical explanation -- a source failing today cannot prove it had no content in 2016, which is the same fallacy as v0_1's source_not_yet_active. No source was deleted or disabled: that belongs to the Owner's user-center sync gate. release_mode PRODUCTION; live 39b87041c284 -> bd0f14211005.

test_results.command: edge reachability probe (wrangler dev --remote; never deployed)
test_results.observed: cell 403 / cell-neuron 403 / lancet 403 / science-advances 403 / gnews-us-tech 503 from the edge; the same URLs give 200 with 24/16/32/42/100 items from a normal client. stats-gov: 200, 66358 bytes, 3.4-6.7s across 3 runs -- reachable, slow, well inside the shipped 15s timeout.

test_results.command: shipped parseA0 regex against the LIVE stats.gov.cn page
test_results.observed: 18 distinct article hrefs of the form ./202607/t20260716_1964142.html; the shipped /^\\.\\/\\d{6}\\/t\\d{8}_\\d+\\.html$/ matches 15 of them. Parser correct; P04's '15 items' verified. The first probe's '0 matches for /sj/zxfb/' was the probe's wrong expectation (relative hrefs), not a defect.

test_results.command: P09 acceptance + the new health assertions
test_results.observed: exit 0. New: unhealthy sources are named on the page (stats-gov: degraded, lancet: disabled_auto), AND COV_REASON still contains no fetch_failed/source_disabled -- health must never become a per-cell historical excuse, the same discipline as refusing source_not_yet_active. per-cell verdicts remain covered/not_backfilled with covered+not_backfilled==cells.

6 tests. New invariant: a PRODUCTION bundle must record an ACTUAL change (live_build_before != live_build_after) -- a sheet copied from the previous phase is a false record of what went live. Load-bearing: setting before==after -> exit 1; restored -> exit 0.

build.json bd0f14211005; / /radar /system /watchlist all 200; /system renders both '从未抓到过任何条目的源：6 个' and '抓取异常：6 个 (cell：degraded、cell-neuron：degraded、lancet：degraded、science-advances：disabled_auto、stats-gov：degraded、gnews-us-tech：disabled_auto)'.

stop_conditions: 不要为了让这 6 个源『不再显示异常』而删掉或停用它们 —— 来源增删属 Owner 的 user-center 同步门。
不要用代理/付费出口去绕 403/503：违反 DIR-007，且绕过反爬不该由实施者擅自决定。
不要把 health 下沉成 per-cell 的历史解释 —— 那是 v0_1 source_not_yet_active 的同一个谬误。
